name: ExerciseDB
tagline: Exercise library with GIF demos, body-part and equipment filters via RapidAPI
description: ExerciseDB provides a large library of exercise data with animated GIF demonstrations, searchable and filterable by body part, target muscle, and equipment. Hosted primarily on RapidAPI, it is commonly used in fitness and workout apps for exercise catalogs, routine builders, and demo media.

auth.details: RapidAPI key via X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host headers; self-serve signup on RapidAPI

example.response_snippet: [{"id":"0001","name":"3/4 sit-up","bodyPart":"waist","equipment":"body weight","gifUrl":"https://v2.exercisedb.io/image/...","target":"abs","secondaryMuscles":["hip flexors","lower back"],"instructions":["Lie flat on your back with your knees bent..."]}]

use_cases: list exercises by body part for a workout planner
filter exercises by equipment available at home
show animated GIF demos for exercise form
search exercises by target muscle group
build a catalog of beginner bodyweight moves
